Event.description: type is sketch_status, spec, message, handoff or feedback; the remaining fields depend on the type (sketch_id or message_id or handoff_id, status, reason, session_slug, version, feedback_id and kind).
Event.title: Event

Feedback.description: Something the translator tells the user about the sketch, kept apart from the document. spec_version is the version written by the same turn, null when the turn wrote none.
Feedback.title: Feedback

Geometry.description: Notebook grid of the page in page-canvas px.
Geometry.title: Geometry

OpTarget.description: Char offsets `[from, to)` in the markdown source line of `line_id` and the text there.
OpTarget.title: OpTarget

PictureRegion.description: A freehand picture of a page: embedded as `![image](images/<id>.png)` from its PNG part.
PictureRegion.title: PictureRegion

RevertIn.description: Body of a revert: the latest spec version the app shows.
RevertIn.title: RevertIn

Segment.description: New handwriting of one row, split at gaps wider than two cells.
Segment.title: Segment

layout.0.json.description: optional notebook layout.<i>.json of pages[i] (JSON PageLayout, at most APPCONN_MAX_LAYOUT_BYTES). Stroke indices refer to strokes.<i>.json (no strokes part means no indices), rects and segments lie inside the canvas, op ids are unique uuids never reported before (409 op_replayed), line ids exist in base_version and each target quote equals the source text at [from, to) (422 stale_target).

meta.description: JSON: {"client_id": uuid, "conversation": "current"|"new", "conversation_id"?: uuid, "caption"?: string, "pages": [{"page": int, "canvas": {"w", "h", "dpi"}, "regions"?: [{"id": uuid, "rect": [x, y, w, h], "part": "region.<i>.<k>.png"}]}], "annotates"?: {"spec_version": int >= 1, "pages": [{"page": int, "doc_page": int, "lines": [int, int]}]}}. annotates needs conversation_id and answers 404 no_spec when that spec version does not exist. Part i (sketch.<i>.png, strokes.<i>.json) belongs to pages[i]; every page needs its png. "base_version"?: int >= 1 is the spec version whose text the board showed; it needs conversation_id, excludes annotates, is required when any layout carries ops, and answers 409 stale_base when it is not the latest version. Each page may carry "regions" (PictureRegion): pictures of pages[i] embedded as ![image](images/<id>.png), allowed with or without a layout.

region.0.0.png.description: region.<i>.<k>.png: the PNG named by exactly one image op of pages[i] or one entry of pages[i].regions (k < APPCONN_MAX_REGIONS_PER_PAGE). Every region part must be named and every named part present. Stored for the conversation's lifetime and served by the images route; counts toward the upload size and the device quota.

Spec.description: layout is null for versions not written from notebook pages; otherwise it maps every markdown source line to its stable line id and lists the op statuses.
Spec.title: Spec

SpecLine.description: One markdown source line (1-based) of a stored version and its stable id.
SpecLine.title: SpecLine

TaskboardError.description: error body of the taskboard, passed through by the task relay
TaskboardError.title: TaskboardError

VisibleRun.description: A rendered spec line as the board showed it.
VisibleRun.title: VisibleRun
